gloss: outside the range; out of scope; out of bounds

definitions.gloss: outside the range; out of scope; beyond the limits
definitions.explanation: Outside a defined range, area, or scope. Composed of {範囲|はんい} (range, scope) plus the suffix {外|がい} (outside).

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{範囲外|はんいがい}だ。
⟦{電波|でんぱ}→電波：04070_denpa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{範囲外|はんいがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{範囲外|はんいがい}です。
examples.english: That question is outside my area of responsibility.

notes:
⟦{範囲|はんい}→範囲：03567_hani⟧ (range, scope) plus the suffix ⟦{外|がい}→外〜：03948_gai⟧ (outside). The antonym is ⟦{範囲内|はんいない}→範囲内：25429_haninai⟧ (within range).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{電波|でんぱ}→電波：04070_denpa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{範囲外|はんいがい}: out of signal range
- ⟦{対象|たいしょう}→対象：03393_taishou⟧{範囲外|はんいがい}: not covered / not eligible
- ⟦{想定|そうてい}→想定：12623_soutei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{範囲外|はんいがい}: beyond what was anticipated

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{範囲内|はんいない}→範囲内：25429_haninai⟧: within the range / within the scope
